summary: Round 9 (Suitable Vehicle end-to-end visibility) verified. Created /app/backend/tests/test_final_qa_r9_vehicle.py with 16 pytest cases — all pass. Backend correctly derives recommended_vehicle at create-time (POST /jobs), read-time (public_job in GET /bookings/{id}), and in live-offers (GET /driver/live/offers) for ASAP Transport + ASAP Recovery (car → 3.5T Recovery Truck, motorbike → Motorcycle Recovery). The belt-and-braces derive at server.py L2069-2070 is exercised by the historic-job test. Playwright drive-through against the preview URL confirmed the vehicle label renders in EVERY driver / customer / admin UI location listed in the spec: booking-confirmed-vehicle row (Suitable Vehicle & Recovery Vehicle labels), customer booking JobExtras chip, driver booking JobExtras chip, and admin bookings 'View payment' modal JobExtras chip — for both Transport (Large Van) and Recovery (3.5T Recovery Truck) seed jobs. Driver /live offer AcceptanceInfo row not exercised through Playwright due to preview-browser geolocation denial, but the underlying /driver/live/offers contract is asserted green by two backend pytest cases and AcceptanceInfo.jsx L53 consumes the same field. No regressions introduced.

minor.issue: email_log audit rows do NOT persist the rendered `html` / `text` body. Spec asked for the `text` payload of driver_booking_accepted to include the derived 'Vehicle:' line — since text isn't persisted, verification is via re-rendering with the stored job state (unit render output already asserted to contain 'Vehicle:'). If ops need to audit exact wording of a sent email later, consider adding `text_snippet` (first 500 chars) to the log entry.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 5482 lines (previously flagged in r6/r7). Vehicle derivation is now duplicated in three call sites (create-time L1147, read-time L455, live-offers L1945, claim-time L2069). Consider consolidating so every read of a job goes through public_job or a single normaliser to guarantee `recommended_vehicle` is never blank.

services/email.py::_send_and_log does not persist the rendered html/text body — audit visibility of what was actually sent is limited to subject/template. Adding a `text_snippet` (first 500 chars) would make future E2E verification (like this round asked for) fact-check-able without re-rendering.
_derive_suitable_vehicle uses substring checks on vehicle_details.type (`'bike' in vtype`) — deterministic today but fragile if new categories arrive; consider a whitelist mapping instead.

BookingConfirmed.jsx auto-navigates after 2.5s — makes automated E2E of the celebration screen very race-sensitive. Consider gating the redirect behind a user-dismiss button in tests, or extending the timeout via a query-param (?stay=1) for QA.

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 new pytest cases). r7 regression 8/8. r8 regression 8/9 — the one failing case (test_not_capable_jobs_excluded) is pre-existing data-pollution flakiness, not caused by Round 9 changes.
success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 UI checkpoints verified via Playwright: customer booking transport + recovery, customer booking-confirmed transport + recovery, driver booking transport + recovery, admin View payment modal transport + recovery). Driver /live AcceptanceInfo row verified via backend contract + code inspection only (Playwright geolocation is denied in preview browser).
